sources.title: Amazon S3: Checking object integrity during upload
sources.version_or_commit: AWS S3 User Guide, live documentation; page version not stated
sources.locator: Multipart uploads; full-object checksums; checksum algorithm behavior
sources.observed_operation: Amazon S3 multipart checksum initiation, UploadPart, completion and checksum retrieval
sources.claim_scope: Multipart full-object checksums support CRC64NVME, CRC32, and CRC32C; SHA-256 is composite-only; multipart ETag is not full-object MD5; documented checksum part numbers are consecutive starting at 1.

sources.applicability: AWS-specific; choose only after the archive provider's end-to-end checksum support and scope are confirmed.

reviser_sources.title: Resumable uploads | Cloud Storage | Google Cloud Documentation
reviser_sources.version_or_commit: Live Google Cloud documentation; page/API version not stated
reviser_sources.locator: JSON API and XML API resumable initiation; browser CORS at session creation; querying the persisted offset; session URI handling and expiry; integrity checks
reviser_sources.observed_operation: Google Cloud Storage JSON API resumable upload: POST Object with uploadType=resumable, receive a session URI, then issue one or more PUT Object requests; query persisted offset and resume after an error
reviser_sources.claim_scope: The session URI is used for upload requests and expires after one week; after an error, a client can query the persisted offset and resume. The documentation recommends final-object integrity checking and states intermediate portions/chunks cannot be integrity-checked.
reviser_sources.conditions_defaults_exceptions: For browser cross-origin uploads, include Origin when initiating the session or subsequent browser requests may lack CORS response headers. The session URI acts as a bearer authentication token and should be protected and used over HTTPS. These are Google Cloud Storage JSON/XML API behaviors.
reviser_sources.applicability: Distinct resumability analogy only, added to satisfy an additive reading of the brief. It is not an archive intake route, provider recommendation, or evidence that the archive endpoint supports these operations.

reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: AWS documentation says nonconsecutive numbers can produce HTTP 500 at CompleteMultipartUpload. The condition is scoped to composite or part-level checksums.
reviser_rechecks.observed_result: Confirmed the omitted condition and narrowed the critic's shorthand 'when using checksum mode' to the primary source's exact checksum type.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: AWS documentation only. The source does not establish the same rule for the unknown archive provider or extend this condition to full-object checksum mode.
